## Python

```{python}
#| results: asis

import platform
import sys
from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version

import pandas as pd

python_packages = {
    "PyCoGAPS": "pycogaps",
    "AnnData": "anndata",
    "pandas": "pandas",
    "NumPy": "numpy",
    "SciPy": "scipy",
    "Matplotlib": "matplotlib",
}

python_session = [
    {"Component": "Python", "Version": sys.version.split()[0]},
    {"Component": "Platform", "Version": platform.platform()},
]

for display_name, package_name in python_packages.items():
    try:
        package_version = version(package_name)
    except PackageNotFoundError:
        package_version = "not installed"
    python_session.append(
        {"Component": display_name, "Version": package_version}
    )

python_session_table = pd.DataFrame(python_session)
print(
    python_session_table.to_html(
        index=False,
        classes="table table-striped table-hover",
        border=0,
    )
)
```
